help.heading: Help & Rules
help.gracePeriod: Grace period: Arriving up to 10 minutes late incurs no remark.
help.lateFormula: From the 11th minute late, a remark is added showing the fractional hours: e.g. 22 min late → "0.36 ...".
help.noRecord: "No Record" remark: used when the employee has no attendance punches at all for the day.
help.noCheckout: "No Checkout" remark: used when the employee checked in but the final scheduled punch has no actual value.
help.zawgyiNote: ⚠ The Burmese remark text (late suffix, no-record, no-checkout) was transcribed from a screenshot of a Zawgyi-encoded file. Verify these strings against your live system before relying on them.
help.authNote: ⚠ Login security note: this is a static site with no server. The login is a basic access-friction layer only — anyone with browser dev tools can read the credentials from config.json. Do not use this to protect sensitive data on a public network.
help.precedence: Remark precedence: No Record > Late Check-in > No Checkout.
